# andersdev.com.br — LLMs.txt

## About
Daniel Anders is a full-stack software developer based in Passo Fundo, RS, Brazil with 15+ years of experience in business and technology. He builds modern web applications, SaaS products, MVPs, and dashboards for startups, SMBs, and digital agencies.

## Services
- SaaS & MVP Development (Next.js, React, TypeScript)
- Real-time Dashboards & Analytics
- API Integrations & Payment Systems (Stripe, Asaas)
- AI/LLM Applications
- Legacy System Migration
- White-label Development for Agencies
